component.name: ResolveDeepLinkTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "resolveDeepLink" end sub
sub resolveDeepLink() m.top.state = "loading"
contentId = TrimString(m.top.contentId) if contentId = "" m.top.error = "No contentId provided" m.top.state = "error" return end if
playlists = LoadPlaylists() if playlists.Count() = 0 m.top.error = "No playlists are saved" m.top.state = "error" return end if
target = LCase(contentId) normalizedTarget = NormalizeName(contentId)
for pIdx = 0 to playlists.Count() - 1 playlist = playlists[pIdx] result = HttpGet(playlist.url, "deeplink_pl_" + playlist.id, 3600) if result.ok channels = ParseM3U(result.body) AnnotateChannels(channels, playlist, pIdx) for cIdx = 0 to channels.Count() - 1 ch = channels[cIdx] if ChannelMatchesDeepLink(ch, target, normalizedTarget, pIdx, cIdx) m.top.channel = BuildDeepLinkPayload(ch, cIdx, channels) m.top.state = "done" return end if end for end if end for
m.top.error = "Content not found" m.top.state = "error" end sub
sub AnnotateChannels(channels as Object, playlist as Object, playlistIndex as Integer) for cIdx = 0 to channels.Count() - 1 ch = channels[cIdx] ch.playlistId = IIF(playlist.id <> invalid, playlist.id, "") ch.playlistName = IIF(playlist.name <> invalid, playlist.name, "Playlist") ch.playlistIndex = playlistIndex ch.channelIndex = cIdx ch.libraryId = ch.playlistId + ":" + Str(cIdx).Trim() end for end sub
function ChannelMatchesDeepLink(channel as Object, target as String, normalizedTarget as String, playlistIndex as Integer, channelIndex as Integer) as Boolean if channel.tvgId <> invalid and LCase(channel.tvgId) = target then return true if channel.tvgName <> invalid and NormalizeName(channel.tvgName) = normalizedTarget and normalizedTarget <> "" then return true if channel.name <> invalid and NormalizeName(channel.name) = normalizedTarget and normalizedTarget <> "" then return true if channel.url <> invalid and LCase(channel.url) = target then return true
stableId = "ssg:" + Str(playlistIndex).Trim() + ":" + Str(channelIndex).Trim() if target = stableId then return true
if channel.playlistId <> invalid and channel.playlistId <> "" idBased = "ssg:" + LCase(channel.playlistId) + ":" + Str(channelIndex).Trim() if target = idBased then return true end if
if channel.libraryId <> invalid and LCase(channel.libraryId) = target then return true
compactId = Str(playlistIndex).Trim() + ":" + Str(channelIndex).Trim() if target = compactId then return true
return false end function
function BuildDeepLinkPayload(channel as Object, index as Integer, channels as Object) as Object playable = [] for each ch in channels playable.Push({ name: IIF(ch.name <> invalid, ch.name, "Unknown Channel"), url: IIF(ch.url <> invalid, ch.url, ""), logo: IIF(ch.logo <> invalid, ch.logo, ""), group: IIF(ch.group <> invalid, ch.group, ""), tvgId: IIF(ch.tvgId <> invalid, ch.tvgId, ""), playlistId: IIF(ch.playlistId <> invalid, ch.playlistId, ""), playlistName: IIF(ch.playlistName <> invalid, ch.playlistName, ""), playlistIndex: IIF(ch.playlistIndex <> invalid, ch.playlistIndex, -1), channelIndex: IIF(ch.channelIndex <> invalid, ch.channelIndex, -1) }) end for
return { name: IIF(channel.name <> invalid, channel.name, "Unknown Channel"), url: IIF(channel.url <> invalid, channel.url, ""), logo: IIF(channel.logo <> invalid, channel.logo, ""), group: IIF(channel.group <> invalid, channel.group, ""), tvgId: IIF(channel.tvgId <> invalid, channel.tvgId, ""), playlistId: IIF(channel.playlistId <> invalid, channel.playlistId, ""), playlistName: IIF(channel.playlistName <> invalid, channel.playlistName, ""), playlistIndex: IIF(channel.playlistIndex <> invalid, channel.playlistIndex, -1), channelIndex: IIF(channel.channelIndex <> invalid, channel.channelIndex, -1), index: index, channels: playable } end function
